Subject: MAP kickoff — Redwood MAP draft & timeline options (Greenline Health)

Hi Jordan + Sophie,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — great conversation and clear priorities. As promised, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to capture milestones, owners, and our recommended timeline options so we can align on next steps.

Quick recap from our call:
- Primary use case: patient triage and secure summary generation for clinical teams
- Success criteria: sub-200ms p95 latency for short prompts, HIPAA-compliant audit & key management, and predictable unit economics at scale
- Key stakeholders: Jordan (Product), Sophie (Clinical Ops), CISO (security review), Procurement

Attached MAP highlights (high level):
1) Kickoff & discovery workshop — Redwood-led, 1.5 hours (we'll surface integration points and data flow)
2) Technical deep-dive & trial environment setup — Aditya to lead (env, whitelisting, sample dataset)
3) Security & compliance review — provide SOC 2 evidence pack + questionnaire turnarounds
4) Commercial & SOW — Neha to coordinate pricing and draft SOW
5) Pilot and evaluation (4–8 weeks) — metrics check-ins and quality gates

Two timeline options (pick which you prefer):
A) Conservative (recommended): 12 weeks to production pilot
   - Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence review (2–3 weeks), procurement approvals (2–4 weeks), network/testing windows
B) Accelerated: ~6 weeks to pilot (requires prioritized security reviews, dedicated sandbox access, and fast procurement)

Ask: please confirm who needs to be included on the MAP (specifically security & procurement contacts), and which timeline you prefer as the baseline. Once we have that, we'll lock dates and circulate an updated MAP with milestone dates and acceptance criteria.

Proposed kickoff slots (Pacific time):
- Thu Jun 12, 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Mon Jun 16, 2:00–3:30 PM PT

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_GreenlineHealth_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
